items.title: 68251_Teddy McRae oral history interview
items.q: When Bob Rolontz got this label, I took Jack Dupree over there. We made one -- I made one side... Anyway, what we did, Bob Rolontz -- only he had Piano Red out of Chicago... So when I walked in... I got this all star band.

ctx.x: Did they get into the USO activities?
